visualDirection: Nocturne Room: calm, editorial, cinematic private-group chat with warm paper light and moonlit dark surfaces.

constraints.backendContracts: Preserve REST, MongoDB, authentication, and Socket.IO contracts

decisions: Storybook is the rendered implementation source of truth.
21st.dev is a private research and pattern-discovery layer; useful patterns are rebuilt locally.
Storybook stories never require MongoDB, Socket.IO, credentials, or network access.
Figma remains a visual reference through Storybook Designs links.
Chromatic is installed and ready locally but is not published without explicit approval.
